programmes.d: A serial killer is prowling Bissonnet street in Houston, and is targeting prostitutes. Detective Wallace and Benjamin are on the case, and will stop at nothing to bring him to justice.

Deeply indebted gambling addict, Curtis, decides to steal from drug dealer, Vic, to pay off his debts. Curtis then tries to leave town with his girlfriend Sasha, but things go completely awry when Vic confronts them before they can skip town.
The ups and downs in the career of Hollywood actress and comedian Kiki Melendez.

Candace's life changes when she meets charismatic Karlton Moore, who seems perfect with his looks, charm and achievements. Their dreamy romance soon becomes a nightmare after his hidden truths come to the surface.

The lives of Mahogany Andrews and those around her are drastically changed after devastating news changes relationships and reveals dark secrets from the past that will have a major impact on everyone's future.

Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother's life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime, leading her down a dangerous path where she will be forced to reflect on her past life choices.

A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programmes.d: Rising Celebrity News Reporter, Cherish has old flames and new loves collide when her past with her ex-Khalil returns, alongside the return of Caine, who threatens everything she's built. Will she choose true love or stay the course for her career?
After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.
Two undercover agents set out to track down a drug kingpin.
There is no "Heartbreak 101" or Graduate-level Backstabbing Courses on the syllabus, and nothing covered in a classroom can prepare you for the harsh realities of the real world.

Lancaster: Host Crystal Powell travels Dallas and tours historic Lancaster, Texas. Crystal takes you on a soulful and wholesome journey to family-owned and operated Casserole Soul Café. Followed by a snip from Crystal's stand-up special at SXSW!

Brandon and Leo are two friends stuck at a dead-end job, until their boss gets arrested and the two seem to be on the upswing. Now between hiding from the IRS, a rival dealership, the road back to respectability is a long and bumpy road.

When sheltered college student Angel, the daughter of the police chief, falls for Romelle "Demon" Montez, the ruthless leader of the South Side Mob, they become star-crossed lovers. Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence.

When the remains of an apartheid-era policeman are discovered 60 years after he went missing, a retired singer revisits her past to help with the investigation. But how much does she know, and what is she holding back?
